propositions: Four graph functions (_find_direct_blockers CCN 18, _get_all_blocked_by CCN 20, check_cycle_at_level CCN 16, detect_newly_unblocked CCN 22) exceed moderate cyclomatic complexity thresholds in the ratchet baseline.
The reduce_all → drop error/fsck → index loop is duplicated verbatim in _find_direct_blockers and _compute_dep_graph, driving CCN growth via duplication.
Graph query logic is hand-rolled per call-site rather than using shared helper functions, with two distinct patterns (_loader.py and BFS skeletons) recurring across four functions.
Extracting shared helpers load_indexed_states and accumulator bfs skeleton into _loader.py and _relations.py enables deduplication while preserving node-sets and traversal behavior identically.

The accumulator BFS must return blocked targets unconditionally (including those with no backing ticket dir) and exclude the seed id, unlike a visited-set return, to preserve check_would_create_cycle semantics.
